paragraphs: Searidge Technologies sells digital tower and airport systems, and says no one type of digital tower can meet all the different needs of an airport. The company describes five digital tower models, each designed for a different challenge and all operating on the same software platform. Its Chorus platform is described as a cloud-native, open digital platform that integrates real-time aviation data. Airfield Insights is presented as an AI-powered analytics solution that transforms data into real-time, actionable insights. Another product gives airport operators a live panoramic view of apron, de-icing, and aircraft parking areas.

The company says it has worked exclusively with Airports and Air Navigation Service Providers (ANSPs) worldwide for 20 years. Searidge is owned by NATS (UK), a tier one ANSP, and continues to operate as an independent business. Technology is in place at over 50 sites in 25 countries, according to the company.

The customers page says Searidge enables airports, airlines, and ANSPs to run airside operations. Named customers include Manchester Airport, Ottawa International Airport Authority, and Malta Air Traffic Services. Organisations listed on that page include the Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore and Bahrain Ministry of Transportation and Telecommunications.
